item.title: Another Construction Project on the Edge of the Uluwatu Cliffs Concerns Locals
item.description: For the last two years, construction has proliferated Uluwatu. Now, a new project built on the edge of the cave entrance to the surf spot has locals agitated.

item.title: After Abandoning Pursuit of Surfing, U.S. Ski & Snowboard Is Now Targeting Skateboarding
item.description: After dropping a campaign to become surfing's governing body, a new report reveals that U.S. Ski & Snowboard is attempting a similar move with skateboarding.

item.title: Ian Gottron Is the Most Well-Rounded Surfer You Haven’t Heard of (Yet)
item.description: Ian Gottron is not a guy who is stuck on one kind of surfboard. If he can stand on it on a wave, he's going to rip on it. Need proof? Here's 15 minues of it.

item.title: Nias Had a Rare Long Period Swell In January; It Was Empty and Picture Perfect
item.description: Lagundri Bay, more generally known simply as Nias, doesn't generally do much in January. Or it usually is, anyway. Sure, it wasn't huge, but it was PERFECT.

item.title: Cape Solander at Its Absolute Wildest Is Not for the Faint of Heart
item.description: When Cape Solander goes off, it goes OFF. This footage is a year old, but it shows one of the craziest days ever filmed at one of Australia's craziest waves.

item.title: Snowboarder Mia Jones Wins FIS Freeride World Championship
item.description: Mia Jones, daughter of legendary snowboarder Jeremy Jones, won the inaugural FIS Freeride World Championship in Andorra, her second event win of the season.

item.title: Canadian Snowboarder Dies After Falling 82 Feet Into Waterfall Basin
item.description: A Canadian snowboarder has died while snowboarding at a Japanese ski resort. The 39-year-old fell into an 82-foot-tall waterfall basin.

item.title: $100 Million Gift Creates First-Ever Pension for Team USA Athletes
item.description: The only payment Team USA athletes have earned through the USOPC previously was for medalling: $38,000 for Gold, $23,000 for Silver, and $15,000 for Bronze.

item.title: Olympic Committee President Promised ‘Uncomfortable’ Cuts to Sports in 2032; Will Surfing Survive?
item.description: International Olympic Committee President Kirsty Coventry warned of major changes to come to the Games' sports program. Where does surfing stand?

item.title: Trew Gear Trewth Bib Primo Review: The New Best Ski Bib on the Market?
item.description: The Trew Gear Trewth Bib Primo just got a major upgrade. Is it now the Best Overall Ski Bib on the market?
